title: VisitLogBook_New
description: Schema for a document in the 'VisitLogBook_New' collection. Records a volunteer's outreach visit log (current iOS/Android version with expanded fields).

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the volunteer who created this log.

timeStamp.description: The timestamp when the log was created. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

whenVisit.description: The date/time of the outreach visit. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

lastEdited.description: The timestamp when the log was last edited. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

followUpWhenVisit.description: Scheduled follow-up visit date/time. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

whereVisit.description: Description of where the outreach visit took place.

locationDescription.description: Additional free-text description of the visit location.

type.description: The platform used to submit the log (e.g., 'iOS', 'Android').

status.description: Approval status of the log. Valid options: pending, approved, rejected.

isPublic.description: Whether this log is publicly visible.

isFlagged.description: Whether this log has been flagged for review.

flaggedByUser.description: UID of the user who flagged this log, if applicable.

peopleHelped.description: Number of people helped during the visit.

peopleHelpedDescription.description: Free-text description of the people helped.

peopleNeedFurtherHelp.description: Number of people identified as needing further help.

peopleNeedFurtherHelpComment.description: Free-text comment about people needing further help.

peopleNeedFurtherHelpLocation.description: Location of people who need further help.

rating.description: Volunteer's self-reported rating of the visit.

otherNotes.description: General free-text notes about the visit.

futureNotes.description: Notes about future plans or follow-ups.

volunteerAgain.description: Whether the volunteer would go again.

whatGivenFurther.description: List of additional support categories provided.

furtherOtherNotes.description: Free-text notes about further help provided.
